content: Hello, I am Beacon Assurance's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Emery West?
Yes, this is Emery West speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your policyholder code?
Could you please tell me your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue insurance premiums. Your insurance policy has 480.00 past due and is 3 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
I paid it yesterday... hang on, no, this says scheduled for tomorrow, not completed. So there's a 480 payment set to go out on October fifteenth; I'd rather let that one go through than pay it twice.
To confirm: the insurance policy, 480.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm: 480.00 for the insurance policy on Thursday 15 October 2026. It's only scheduled, not paid yet, so it won't have reached you until then.
Your promise is recorded: the insurance policy, 480.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Your receipt will be sent by post. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thanks for your help. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
